steps.text: Call and response is music's oldest conversation: a phrase asks, a phrase answers. Blues, gospel, jazz — all built on it. Two bars is all you need.
steps.title: CONVERSATION

steps.text: The call: G4 on step 1. Short, and it ends on the fifth — unstable, asking a question. Calls end open.
steps.title: CALL

steps.text: A4 on step 3, still climbing. The question hangs in the air…
steps.title: CLIMB

steps.text: Now answer it: land somewhere restful. Try G4 (67) on step 8, E4 (64) on step 10, C4 (60) on step 12 — descending to the tonic. Responses end closed.
steps.title: RESPONSE

steps.text: Hear the grammar? Open phrase, closed phrase — question, answer. Write your next melody as a conversation and it'll never ramble.
steps.title: DONE
